title: Bias Mitigation in Audio-Enabled LLMs through Adversarial Training and Distillation Methods
abstract: arXiv:2610.21763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audio-enabled large language models (AuLLMs) allow users to interact with them simply by talking to them, without the need for an intermediate transcription. This expands the model's accessibility and capabilities by encoding non-verbal cues. However, using non-verbal cues may lead to biased behaviour based on the attributes inferred (or assumed) from them. In this work, we focus on the gender attribute and show that models' perception of it can be unlearned using adversarial methods without a loss in performance on other benchmarked tasks. Such models are useful in situations where gender inference is unwanted. However, in other practical settings, gender perception (without bias) may be desired.As a less radical measure, we distil the gender-agnostic model, creating a model that perceives gender but responds similarly to the gender-agnostic teacher, unless explicitly asked.We apply our newly proposed methods to three AuLLMs and obtain

translated_title: 通过对抗训练与蒸馏方法缓解音频增强大语言模型中的偏见
translated_abstract: 音频增强大语言模型（AuLLMs）使用户能够直接通过语音与其交互，而无需中间转录步骤。这通过编码非语言线索扩展了模型的可访问性和能力。然而，使用非语言线索可能导致模型基于从中推断（或假定）的属性而产生有偏见的行为。在本工作中，我们聚焦于性别属性，并证明可以通过对抗方法使模型“遗忘”对性别的感知，且在其他基准任务上不会损失性能。此类模型在不需要性别推断的场景中非常有用。然而，在其他实际场景中，可能需要（无偏见的）性别感知。作为一种较为温和的措施，我们对性别无关模型进行蒸馏，创建了一个能够感知性别、但除非被明确询问否则响应与性别无关教师模型相似的模型。我们将新提出的方法应用于三个音频增强大语言模型，并获得了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出两种缓解音频增强大语言模型偏见的方法：对抗训练使模型“遗忘”性别感知而不损失性能，以及蒸馏方法构建既保留性别感知又能像性别无关教师模型一样给出无偏见回答的模型。
